scope: Focused primary-source novelty screen, not an exhaustive priority claim

sources.title: Tex3D: Objects as Attack Surfaces via Adversarial 3D Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.established_overlap: Differentiable scene compositing, object textures, trajectory-aware frame prioritization and vertex parameterization.
sources.consequence: These components are inherited baselines, not new RefCloth contributions.

sources.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.established_overlap: A shared object-bound texture, joint task optimization, native action-space targets and cross-model evaluation.
sources.consequence: A universal texture or adding an action loss alone does not establish a distinct contribution.

sources.title: TRAP: Hijacking VLA CoT-Reasoning via Adversarial Patches
sources.established_overlap: Physical visual patches can hijack intermediate reasoning in CoT-based policies.
sources.consequence: A background carrier alone is not a sufficient novelty claim; current non-CoT scope must remain explicit.

sources.title: Black-Box Adversarial Patch Attacks on VLAs via Ancestor VLM Exploitation
sources.established_overlap: Ancestor-only visual and instruction-grounding attacks, and model-dependent limits of inherited transfer.
sources.consequence: Moving feature losses to an ancestor or combining vision/language terms is already occupied.

sources.title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
sources.established_overlap: A printable texture with trajectory-aware representation alignment and task refinement for video and world models.
sources.consequence: Generic temporal alignment or shared adversarial embedding is not a strong standalone novelty direction.

sources.title: Causal Analysis of Robot Foundation Models Enables Efficiency Gains
sources.established_overlap: Activation interventions identify a limited action-conditioning interface; representation changes are not automatically causal action changes.
sources.consequence: Feature-fidelity gains require decoder and native-update validation, not only cosine or MSE.

sources.title: Synthesizing Robust Adversarial Examples
sources.established_overlap: Expectation over transformations and physical 3D adversarial optimization.
sources.consequence: EoT and basic texture-to-image differentiability are established foundations.

current_candidate.description: State-conditioned source-native secant transport of feature displacement
current_candidate.rationale: An empirical crossed diagnostic found far worse residual-basis retention across late states than across new textures at seen states.
current_candidate.mathematical_novelty: The minimum-norm ridge/secant mapping is standard linear algebra and is not claimed as a new theorem.
current_candidate.possible_contribution: A source-only deployment calibration procedure that corrects state-dependent displacement directions, with explicit probe costs and native-gradient validation.
required_evidence: Unseen probe textures and fresh source states
True native-rendered gradient and step comparison
Paired short-training regression before a full training claim
Matched-compute closed-loop evaluation on unchanged target policies
